data.description:
## Description
**What**: Implement plugins/dso/scripts/negative-examples-lookup.sh that reads a task's file_impact + claimable_intent, queries closed negative-example bugs by bug-type slug via existing ticket-CLI primitives, excludes promoted-to-standard:* and stale (related_files referencing on-disk-missing paths) tickets, ranks by narrower-scope-preferred + recency with deterministic ticket-id lexical tie-breaking, returns top-N=3 matches as JSON with an excluded_count field and a concise per-match summary {slug, missed_signal_summary, generalizable_lesson}, and supports an --output-file flag for ARG_MAX safety.
**Why**: This is the retrieval half of the loop; the test-writer prompts (draft-4) consume its output.
**Scope**:
- IN: lookup script; relevance ranking; staleness auto-check; promoted-tag exclusion; tie-breaking; top-3 JSON; excluded_count; concise summary; --output-file.
- OUT: prompt integration (draft-4); the end-to-end fixtures (draft-8).

## Done Definitions

- negative-examples-lookup.sh reads the task's file_impact and claimable_intent and queries closed bugs tagged negative-example and bug-type-<slug> via existing ticket-CLI primitives ← Satisfies: sc-3
- Tickets carrying any promoted-to-standard:* tag are excluded, and tickets whose related_files reference paths absent on disk are excluded by an auto-staleness check ← Satisfies: sc-3
- Results are ranked with narrower-scoped (smaller related_files) preferred and weighted by recency, and two examples with identical relevance scores are returned in deterministic ticket-id lexical order ← Satisfies: sc-3
- Output is the top-3 matches as JSON including an excluded_count field and a per-match summary of exactly {slug, missed_signal_summary, generalizable_lesson}, and the script writes to the path given by --output-file when supplied (ARG_MAX-safe) ← Satisfies: sc-3
- Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic ← Satisfies: sc-3

## Considerations

- [Dependency] EXTERNAL BLOCKER: slug taxonomy comes from 4911-c7ba; claimable_intent / manifest entries come from 94ed-f55c.
- [Risk] Top-N cutoff can silence critical examples; excluded_count is the structural signal consumed by /dso:retro (draft-5).
- [Determinism] Tie-breaking must be reproducible across runs — lexical ticket-id order, asserted by a RANKING_TIE fixture.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a test-writing sub-agent, I want negative-examples-lookup.sh to retrieve the top-3 relevant learned examples for a task, so that I receive project-specific lessons filtered for relevance, staleness, and promotion state.
